verses.text: Hear, my sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:

verses.text: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

verses.text: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;

verses.text: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;

verses.text: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.

verses.text: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.

verses.text: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.

verses.text: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.
